name: WPS Survey Form Pro
author: Yuhda Ibrahim

sections.description:
WPS Survey Form Pro is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress survey plugin that lets you create and manage professional survey forms directly from your WordPress admin — without writing a single line of code.

Whether you need a customer satisfaction survey, employee feedback form, product research questionnaire, or event registration survey, WPS Survey Form Pro gives you everything you need in one simple plugin.

Why Choose WPS Survey Form Pro?

Most WordPress survey plugins are either too complex or too limited. WPS Survey Form Pro hits the sweet spot — a clean drag-and-drop builder with all the field types you actually need, plus a built-in submissions dashboard so you never lose a response.

Key Features

  • Drag-and-drop field builder — build any survey form in minutes
  • 10 field types — text, textarea, radio, checkbox, dropdown, email, number, date, image checkbox, and star rating
  • Submissions dashboard — view, search, and filter all responses inside WordPress
  • CSV export — download all survey responses with one click
  • Admin email notifications — get notified instantly when someone submits a form
  • Per-form settings — show a custom success message or redirect after submission
  • Shortcode support — embed any survey anywhere with [wps_surveyform id="1"]
  • No coding required — 100% visual builder for any WordPress user

Perfect For

  • Customer satisfaction surveys
  • Employee or team feedback forms
  • Product feedback and NPS surveys
  • Event registration and interest forms
  • Website feedback and user research
  • Student or training questionnaires

How It Works

  1. Go to Survey Forms in your WordPress admin
  2. Click Add New and use the drag-and-drop builder to add your fields
  3. Configure your success message or redirect URL
  4. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget

That’s it. Your WordPress survey form is live and collecting responses.

Submissions & Data

All survey responses are stored securely in your own WordPress database. Use the built-in search and date filters to find specific responses, or export everything to CSV for analysis in Excel or Google Sheets.

Lightweight & Fast

WPS Survey Form Pro is built to be fast. No bloated dependencies, no external scripts loading on every page — only the assets your survey form needs, loaded only where the shortcode is placed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wps-survey-form-pro folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. Go to Survey Forms in the admin menu to create your first survey
  4. Paste the shortcode [wps_surveyform id="1"] into any page or post
sections.faq:
Is this a free WordPress survey plugin?

Yes. WPS Survey Form Pro is completely free to download and use with no feature limits or paywalls.

How do I display a survey on my site?

After creating a survey, copy the shortcode shown in the All Surveys list and paste it into any page, post, or widget area.

Are submissions stored in my database?

Yes. All responses are saved to your WordPress database and are viewable under the Submissions tab of each survey. Your data stays on your own server.

Can I export survey responses?

Yes. Go to the Submissions tab of any survey and click “Export CSV” to download all responses as a spreadsheet.

How many surveys can I create?

There is no limit. You can create as many survey forms as you need.

Can I get email notifications when someone submits a survey?

Yes. WPS Survey Form Pro sends an email notification to the admin email address every time a new response is submitted.

Does it work with the WordPress block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. You can paste the shortcode [wps_surveyform id="1"] into a Shortcode block in the Gutenberg editor.

What field types are supported?

WPS Survey Form Pro supports 10 field types: text, textarea, radio buttons, checkboxes, dropdown, email, number, date picker, image checkbox, and star rating.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin only loads its assets on pages where a survey shortcode is present, keeping your site fast on all other pages.
